item_fields.label: Name
item_fields.desc: What you call this server. Leave it empty to show the address.

item_fields.label: Address
item_fields.desc: The name or IP address of the Signal K server.

item_fields.label: Port
item_fields.desc: Most Signal K servers stream on port 8375. Port 3000 is the web page, not the stream.

item_fields.label: On
item_fields.desc: Off closes the stream and stops reconnecting.
